summary: Configured inventory-worker as an enabled OpenRC service on node1. It runs continuously as the unprivileged inventory user, chrooted to /var/lib/inventory with NoNewPrivs enabled and zero effective capabilities. A node reboot confirmed automatic recovery and persistence.
actions_performed: Created the dedicated inventory user and chroot runtime under /var/lib/inventory.
Installed and enabled the inventory-worker OpenRC service.
Verified advancing heartbeat data, confinement, and privilege restrictions.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its changed boot identity and complete service recovery.

evidence.summary: OpenRC reports the service started and enabled in the default runlevel; heartbeat timestamps advanced before and after reboot.
The live process root is /var/lib/inventory. Runtime data and heartbeat reside beneath its inventory-owned data directory.
Live process evidence shows NoNewPrivs=1, inventory uid/gid, and zero effective and ambient capabilities.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 176b736e-b7ca-45d1-8d46-f30cd6311206 to 5f67be1e-a6fd-415f-854b-9679481a26ef; service, confinement, privilege policy, and heartbeat recovered.
